description: This source file implements the NetworkInterfaceCache class for managing network interfaces on Fuchsia platform, including adding, changing, removing interfaces, and determining connection types.

classes.name: NetworkInterfaceCache
classes.description: Manages network interface properties, tracks changes, and determines connection type for Fuchsia network interfaces.

methods.name: AddInterfaces
methods.description: Adds multiple network interfaces and returns change bits or nullopt on error.

methods.name: AddInterface
methods.description: Adds a single network interface and returns change bits or nullopt on error.

methods.name: AddInterfaceWhileLocked
methods.description: Internal method to add interface with lock held, verifies properties, updates internal state, and returns change bits.

methods.name: ChangeInterface
methods.description: Updates an existing interface and returns change bits or nullopt on error.

methods.name: RemoveInterface
methods.description: Removes an interface by ID and returns change bits or nullopt on error.

methods.name: GetOnlineInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of online, non-loopback interfaces.

methods.name: UpdateConnectionTypeWhileLocked
methods.description: Updates connection type based on current interfaces.

methods.name: SetErrorWhileLocked
methods.description: Internal method to set error state with lock held.
